load_data: load monolingual and parallel datasets from binarized .pth files and return a data dictionary
load_binarized: load a binarized PyTorch dataset from a .pth file and process it with given parameters
check_data_params: validate dataset paths, language configurations, and training step parameters
process_binarized: process a binarized dataset by applying vocabulary limits and logging statistics
load_mono_data: load monolingual datasets for each language into stream and batched dataset objects
